nodes.summary: The Riemann xi function $\xi$ is complex differentiable at every point of $\mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: The Riemann xi function is entire

nodes.summary: Let $\xi$ be the Riemann xi function. If $s$ is a complex number with $\xi(s) = 0$, then $\operatorname{Re}(s) < 1$.
nodes.title: Zeros of the xi function have real part less than one

nodes.summary: Let $\xi$ be the Riemann xi function. If $s$ is a complex number with $\xi(s) = 0$, then $\operatorname{Re}(s) > 0$.
nodes.title: Zeros of the xi function have positive real part

nodes.summary: The Riemann xi function $\xi$ is entire, satisfies $\xi(1 - s) = \xi(s)$ for every complex number $s$, and every complex number $s$ with $\xi(s) = 0$ satisfies $0 < \operatorname{Re}(s) < 1$.
nodes.title: Basic properties of the Riemann xi function

nodes.summary: Let $\xi$ be the Riemann xi function and let $\Lambda$ be the completed Riemann zeta function, the meromorphic continuation of $\pi^{-s/2}\Gamma(s/2)\zeta(s)$, which has simple poles at $s = 0$ and $s = 1$. For every complex number $s$ with $s \ne 0$ and $s \ne 1$, $\xi(s) = \frac{s(s - 1)}{2}\Lambda(s)$.
nodes.title: The xi function in terms of the completed zeta function

nodes.summary: Let $\xi$ be the Riemann xi function. If $s$ is a complex number with $\xi(s) = 0$, then $0 < \operatorname{Re}(s) < 1$.
nodes.title: Zeros of the xi function lie in the critical strip

nodes.summary: Let $\xi$ be the Riemann xi function. For every complex number $s$ with $\operatorname{Re}(s) \ge 1$, $\xi(s) \ne 0$.
nodes.title: The xi function has no zeros with real part at least one

nodes.summary: Let $\xi$ be the Riemann xi function. For every complex number $s$, $\xi(1 - s) = \xi(s)$.
nodes.title: Functional equation of the Riemann xi function

nodes.summary: Let $\Lambda$ be the completed Riemann zeta function, the meromorphic continuation of $\pi^{-s/2}\Gamma(s/2)\zeta(s)$, which has simple poles at $s = 0$ and $s = 1$, and let $\Lambda_0$ be the entire function with $\Lambda_0(s) = \Lambda(s) + \frac{1}{s} + \frac{1}{1 - s}$ for $s \ne 0, 1$. The Riemann xi function is $\xi(s) = \frac{s(s - 1)}{2}\Lambda_0(s) + \frac{1}{2}$ for $s \in \mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Riemann xi function

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
